# Game Idea: Astro Escape

- Player pilots a ship in a scrolling HTML‑canvas space field.
- Use thrust and rotation to dodge incoming asteroids that spawn from the top.
- Asteroids break into smaller fragments on impact, increasing hazard.
- **Lose condition:** ship collides with any asteroid fragment **or** fuel runs out.
- Score is based on time survived or distance traveled.

1: // Simple Astro Escape game – targets <canvas id="game">
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // ----- audio -----
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   let thrustOsc = null;
9:   function startThrustSound() {
10:     if (thrustOsc) return;
11:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     thrustOsc.start();
17:   }
18:   function stopThrustSound() {
19:     if (!thrustOsc) return;
20:     thrustOsc.stop();
21:     thrustOsc.disconnect();
22:     thrustOsc = null;
23:   }
24:   function playCollisionSound() {
25:     const duration = 0.2;
26:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
27:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
28:     oscillator.type = 'square';
29:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime);
30:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
32:     oscillator.start();
33:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
34:   }
35:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
36:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
37: 
38:   // ----- ship -----
39:   const ship = {
40:     x: width / 2,
41:     y: height - 60,
42:     angle: -Math.PI / 2,
43:     vx: 0,
44:     vy: 0,
45:     radius: 10,
46:     thrust: 0.1,
47:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
48:     update() {
49:       // apply velocity
50:       this.x += this.vx;
51:       this.y += this.vy;
52:       // screen wrap
53:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += width;
54:       if (this.x > width) this.x -= width;
55:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += height;
56:       if (this.y > height) this.y -= height;
57:     },
58:     draw() {
59:       ctx.save();
60:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
61:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
62:       ctx.beginPath();
63:       ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
64:       ctx.lineTo(-8, -8);
65:       ctx.lineTo(-5, 0);
66:       ctx.lineTo(-8, 8);
67:       ctx.closePath();
68:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
69:       ctx.fill();
70:       ctx.restore();
71:     }
72:   };
73: 
74:   // ----- asteroids -----
75:   const asteroids = [];
76:   // background stars for better graphics
77:   const stars = [];
78:   const starCount = 100;
79:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
80:     stars.push({
81:       x: Math.random() * width,
82:       y: Math.random() * height,
83:       speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
84:     });
85:   }
86:   const minSize = 8;
87:   function spawnAsteroid() {
88:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 20; // radius 20‑40
89:     asteroids.push({
90:       x: Math.random() * width,
91:       y: -size,
92:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
93:       vy: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.2,
94:       radius: size
95:     });
96:   }
97: 
98:   function splitAsteroid(a) {
99:     if (a.radius / 2 < minSize) return;
100:     for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
101:       asteroids.push({
102:         x: a.x,
103:         y: a.y,
104:         vx: a.vx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
105:         vy: a.vy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
106:         radius: a.radius / 2
107:       });
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   // ----- input -----
112:   const keys = {};
113:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
114:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
115: 
116:   // ----- game state -----
117:   let lastSpawn = 0;
118:   let startTime = performance.now();
119:   let gameOver = false;
120: 
121:   function update(dt) {
122:   // update background stars
123:   for (let s of stars) {
124:     s.y += s.speed * dt * 0.05; // speed proportional to dt
125:     if (s.y > height) {
126:       s.y = 0;
127:       s.x = Math.random() * width;
128:     }
129:   }
130:     if (gameOver) return;
131:     // ship controls
132:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
133:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
134:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
135:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
136:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
137:     }
138:     ship.update();
139: 
140:     // spawn asteroids every 1.5 s
141:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 1500) {
142:       spawnAsteroid();
143:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
144:     }
145: 
146:     // update asteroids
147:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
148:       const a = asteroids[i];
149:       a.x += a.vx;
150:       a.y += a.vy;
151:       // wrap vertically
152:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
153:       // ship‑asteroid collision
154:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
155:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
156:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
157:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
158:         gameOver = true;
159:         return;
160:       }
161:       // asteroid‑asteroid collision – split
162:       for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
163:         const b = asteroids[j];
164:         const ddx = a.x - b.x;
165:         const ddy = a.y - b.y;
166:         const d = Math.hypot(ddx, ddy);
167:         if (d < a.radius + b.radius) {
168:           splitAsteroid(a);
169:           splitAsteroid(b);
170:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
171:           asteroids.splice(j, 1);
172:           break;
173:         }
174:       }
175:     }
176:   }
177: 
178:   function draw() {
179:     // background stars
180:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
181:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
182:     // draw moving stars
183:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
184:     for (let s of stars) {
185:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 2, 2);
186:     }
187:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
188:     // ship
189:     ship.draw();
190:     // asteroids
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
192:     for (const a of asteroids) {
193:       ctx.beginPath();
194:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
195:       ctx.fill();
196:     }
197:     // score
198:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
199:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
200:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
201:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
202:     if (gameOver) {
203:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
204:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
205:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
206:     }
207:   }
208: 
209:   let last = performance.now();
210:   function loop() {
211:     const now = performance.now();
212:     const dt = now - last;
213:     last = now;
214:     update(dt);
215:     draw();
216:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
217:   }
218:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
219: })();

(End of file - total 219 lines)
</content>
